criteria.requirement: Add pluggy.discovery EntryPointCandidate/DiscoveryReport, discover_entrypoints(group,name=None) and load_entrypoint(manager,candidate). Discovery reads actual metadata fields and reports per-distribution metadata errors separately, never ep.load or plugin execution. Explicit loading re-reads group/name/value/distribution/version, requires exactly one complete matching candidate and no metadata errors, rejects stale/ambiguous inventory before import, and loads only the selected entry. Existing/blocked names return None without import. Commit through the earlier register_entrypoint verified path so rejected/None/renamed plugins never corrupt dist associations. Preserve default existing load API, and do not claim metadata preview proves runtime behavior safe.
